title: Web Development
tagline: Websites and web apps built around what you actually need.
description: I design and build websites, landing pages and web applications. I start by understanding what your business needs and writing it down before any code, so we both know what will be delivered.

pageMeta.title: Web Development
pageMeta.description: Custom websites, landing pages and web applications by Luis Camilo Vivas Cruz.

intro.heading: Web Development
intro.subHeading: I build websites and web applications designed around what your business needs. I work in stages: requirements first, then design, development and delivery, with progress you can see at every step.

capabilities.title: Requirements gathering
capabilities.description: We talk through what you need and I turn it into requirements and user stories, so it is clear what will be built and in what order.

capabilities.title: Websites and landing pages
capabilities.description: Informational sites, portfolios and landing pages that load fast and look right on both desktop and mobile.

capabilities.title: Web applications
capabilities.description: Applications with a separate frontend and REST API, like the accommodation marketplace I built with my team using Angular and Spring Boot.

capabilities.title: Quality in every release
capabilities.description: Git with code review, a continuous integration pipeline that builds and runs the tests, and code quality analysis with SonarCloud.

cta.heading: Have a project in mind?
cta.body: Tell me what you need and I'll get back to you with a proposal.

title: Web Consulting
tagline: Helping your business decide what it needs on the web.
description: Not every business needs the same thing. I review your current online presence and recommend what makes sense: a new site, improving the one you have, choosing a domain and hosting, or organizing your team's work.

pageMeta.title: Web Consulting
pageMeta.description: Consulting for businesses that want to know what they need online: website review, technology choices, domain, hosting and a work plan.

intro.heading: Web Consulting
intro.subHeading: If you're not sure what your business needs online, that's where we start. I review where you are today, explain the options and what they cost, and leave you with a concrete plan.

capabilities.title: Website review
capabilities.description: I look at your current site, or the lack of one: speed, mobile version, whether it shows up in search, and whether it explains what you do.

capabilities.title: What to build, and with what
capabilities.description: I walk you through the options (a site builder, a static site or a custom application) and what each one costs to maintain, so you can decide with the facts.

capabilities.title: Domain, hosting and email
capabilities.description: I help you buy a domain, choose hosting and set up email addresses with your business name.

capabilities.title: Organizing the work
capabilities.description: If your team is taking on a web project, I help you organize it with Scrum and tools like Jira and Confluence.

cta.heading: Not sure where to start?
cta.body: Send me a message and we'll work out together what your business needs.
cta.label: Request a consultation →
